[Unique] [Initiation] [Exhaust] [Ephemeral] 350% Defense-Based Damage. Incinerate: Create 1 Hew Lv. 1.
[Unique] [Initiation] [Ignition] [Exhaust] [Retain] 400% Defense-Based Damage. Incinerate: Create 1 Hew (Flash) Lv. 1.
[Unique] [Ignition] [Retain] Change Hew in hand to its final level.
Proc 1 highest-Cost Attack Card(s) of this unit in hand, then Exhaust those cards.

body.en:
Nine's whole kit resolves around Hew
Hew can be leveled up by Incinerating
Incinerate is triggered whenever the card is Exhausted
Incinerate in the case of Hew creates you a Hew +1 level, unless it's maxed
Ephmeral, Fighting Spirit, Rei Exhaust, Fatal Strike
All are ways to Exhaust your Hew to level it up
At Max level Hew no longer Incinerates to make a Hew the same turn
Instead it generates a new Hew at the start of the turn, so you potentially can run out
Ignition:
Decreases cost of the card with Ignition by 1 whenever any ally Exhausts a card

Flash Hew = Best because you can play 4 Hews for 0 AP
Ironclad/Massacre>Extreme
Reasoning
Extreme requires 6 cycles so you need to play Fatal
So +1 AP and +1 Draw required to cycle
At that the AP/Damage Ratio Extreme loses to Ironclad/Massacre without the Utility
Hew Math
